prompt: Show me exactly what deploying the agent in shop/ to the dev environment would do, without changing anything anywhere: no cluster changes, no image builds or pushes. Save the complete plan (the commands and the rendered manifests) to shop/deploy-plan.txt.

checks.why: `deploy --dry-run` prints every docker/helm/kubectl command it would run

reference: From shop/: `graph-agents-cli deploy --env dev --dry-run > deploy-plan.txt 2>&1` prints the docker, helm and kubectl commands (build, load or push, the Secret, `helm upgrade --install ... --wait`) and the rendered manifests, changes nothing and never prompts.
